entries.text: 海岱他找不到錢包，\n現在一定在掉眼淚……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: 請到位在沙漠另一側的[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]漬沁鎮[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n把錢包交給他，拜託[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: 怎麼？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又來啦！？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01a

entries.text: 呃啊～！\n找不到！怎麼會沒有！！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_26

entries.text: 再這樣下去，\n精選商品就要被別人買走了……[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_28

entries.text: 大哥，請冷靜！\n我現在就去跑一趟。一定找得到的！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01b

entries.text: 哎呀，怎麼啦？\n如果是有事要找海岱大哥，\r\n他現在正忙著呢！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_02

entries.text: 不論是誰，要是想礙事的話，\n我這個頭號弟子是不會放過的……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_03

entries.text: 都已經告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳我們這～麼忙了，\n……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還有事想找我們？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_04

entries.text: 有事！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_a

entries.text: 沒事……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_b

entries.text: 那[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還不快回去！\n我們可是很忙的！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這小孩子真不聽話！\n就讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳稍微安靜一點吧！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_06

entries.text: 我的媽呀！\n輸得連私房錢都沒啦！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_07

entries.text: 嘿！吃飽了沒……\n這騷動是怎麼回事……？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_01

entries.text: 海、海岱大哥！\n是這小孩子[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_08

entries.text: 怎麼會有客人來找我這個\n丟了錢包，身無分文的傢伙……？\r\n到底有何貴幹呀……？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_02

entries.text: 錢包！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_01

entries.text: 你忘了這個！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]將海岱的錢包\n交給了道館館主！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_01

entries.text: 啥！是道館櫃台的人\n要[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳送來給我的啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_04

entries.text: 哇、哈、哈！這真是救了我一把！\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跑了這麼一趟路！！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_05

entries.text: 啊～還有，我家的小伙子\n給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳添麻煩了，抱歉啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_06

entries.text: 在漬沁鎮出名的[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]拍賣會[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]上\n有個我們無論如何都想買的東西。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_07

entries.text: 所以兩個人的情緒\n都有點兒激動。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_08

entries.text: 來喲～！走過路過不要錯過！\n今天的壓軸商品上場嘍！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_01

entries.text: 這就是今天的精選商品！\n豐緣地區出產的傳說的海帶！\r\n來喲！看一看！瞧一瞧！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_02

entries.text: 不用摸也看得出\n那營養充沛的彈力！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_11

entries.text: 那反射光線後\n耀眼奪目的色澤！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_12

entries.text: 以及那藏也藏不住的\n新鮮芳醇的大海氣味！！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_13

entries.text: 小朋友，要是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想挑戰玻瓶道館，\n夠不夠上道是很重要的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_15

entries.text: 這是個好機會！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就代替我\n在拍賣會標下那個食材吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_16

entries.text: 拍賣會？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_03

entries.text: 我試試看！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_04

entries.text:
在拍賣會呢……可以透過和其他客人
出價競標，來購買想要的商品！\c
精打細算自己手裡有多少錢，
然後在競標時喊出最高價的人，
就能買到那個商品！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_17

entries.text: 哇、哈、哈！小小年紀就知道\n什麼是拍賣會啊！？\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這個小朋友真是不簡單！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_18

entries.text: 這些零用錢給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳當競標用的資金！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可要好好幫我標到那個食材啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_19

entries.text: 那麼，要開始嘍！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_01

entries.text: 豐緣地區出產的傳說的海帶！\n起價是[VAR 0x0205(0001,0000)]！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_02

entries.text: 目前的價格是[VAR 0x0205(0002,0000)]……\n要出價多少？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_system_01

entries.text: 觀望一下
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_select_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]

entries.text: 來！[VAR 0x0205(0001,0000)]成交！\n恭喜那邊那位少爺嘍！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_04a

entries.text: 來！[VAR 0x0205(0001,0000)]成交！\n恭喜那邊那位小姐嘍！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_04b

entries.text: 不輸給大人的角力戰！\n哎呀～！真是了不起啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_20

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳幫我標到的海帶，\n我就心懷感恩地收下啦。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_21

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]將傳說的海帶\n交給了海岱！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_02

entries.text: 多麼棒的東西啊！\n要是沒辦法把它弄到手的話，\r\n我可要發愁發得白髮千丈啦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_22

entries.text:
剩下的資金就當作是謝禮，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳收下吧！\c
要拿去參加其他的競標也行，
隨便[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳怎麼用都好！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_23

entries.text: ……那麼，\n我要先回玻瓶道館去啦。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_24

entries.text: 男子漢海岱！我會回去準備好\n新鮮生猛的對戰，等著[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_25
